{"question":"按叙述顺序仅检索空弦剧场记录1及此前章节。","operation":"chapter-cutoff","view":"author","branch":"canon","retrievalStatus":"matched","diagnostics":[],"documents":[{"documentId":"D1","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"贺弦把一根替弦放进舞台左箱，并承诺首演前修好断弦琴；左箱盖上的白线是取弦标记。剧场规约写明：断弦琴换上完整琴弦并试音后才可登台。幕布下缘缀着蓝色流苏。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-8CA0","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A1aebe987-1791-4d34-9461-efdefec97acc:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:1aebe987-1791-4d34-9461-efdefec97acc"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["贺弦把一根替弦放进舞台左箱，并承诺首演前修好断弦琴；左箱盖上的白线是取弦标记。剧场规约写明：断弦琴换上完整琴弦并试音后才可登台。幕布下缘缀着蓝色流苏。"]},{"documentId":"D2","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"温宁听到过时消息，以为替弦在右箱；贺弦亲手放过替弦，知道它在左箱，准备按承诺修琴。贺弦依照白线标记打开左箱，取出为首演准备的替弦。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-8CA0","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A3528404c-b361-476d-bbcb-e0f3deb8eb0b:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:3528404c-b361-476d-bbcb-e0f3deb8eb0b"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["温宁听到过时消息，以为替弦在右箱；贺弦亲手放过替弦，知道它在左箱，准备按承诺修琴。贺弦依照白线标记打开左箱，取出为首演准备的替弦。"]},{"documentId":"D3","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"贺弦换弦并完成试音，修琴承诺兑现，白线标记得到回收；温宁仍依据旧消息去右箱寻找替弦。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-8CA0","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A7a8ad521-6cf1-4135-b90b-2f50f5dcb7a4:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:7a8ad521-6cf1-4135-b90b-2f50f5dcb7a4"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["贺弦换弦并完成试音，修琴承诺兑现，白线标记得到回收；温宁仍依据旧消息去右箱寻找替弦。"]},{"documentId":"D4","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"染布工另给窗帘染色，窗帘不用于首演，也不影响琴弦。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-8CA0","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A944dc421-0a98-4234-8c7c-95bccb1f40e1:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:944dc421-0a98-4234-8c7c-95bccb1f40e1"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["染布工另给窗帘染色，窗帘不用于首演，也不影响琴弦。"]}]}
